units.source_text: 那位從背後戳我的男子，相貌普通，在班裡身體最為瘦弱，

en.t: The boy who poked me from behind was ordinary in appearance and had the frailest body in the class,

units.source_text: 臉色蒼白略帶浮腫，總是穿著像是父親或哥哥穿過的舊上衣，衣袖又寬又長，彷彿聖德太子[1]。

en.t: his face was pale and slightly puffy, and he was always wearing an old jacket that looked as if it had belonged to his father or elder brother, with sleeves so wide and long that he resembled Prince Shotoku[1].

units.source_text: 他的功課一塌糊塗，在軍訓和上體操課時，總像白痴一樣站在一旁觀看。

en.t: His schoolwork was hopeless, and during military drill and gymnastics classes he always stood off to the side watching like an idiot.

units.source_text: 就連我也覺得根本沒必要提防他。

en.t: Even I felt there was absolutely no need to be on guard against him.

units.source_text: 有一天上體育課的時候，就是那位叫竹一的同學（記不清他姓什麼了，只記得名字叫竹一），

en.t: One day during physical education class, that classmate named Takeichi, whose surname I cannot remember and whose given name alone I recall,

units.source_text: 依舊站在一旁觀看我們練習單槓，

en.t: was standing off to the side as usual, watching us practice on the horizontal bar,

units.source_text: 我故意裝得一臉嚴肅，高叫一聲：「看我的！」

en.t: I deliberately put on a solemn face and shouted, "Watch me!"
